voice.name: Open Sector - Heavy Assimilator
voice.note: Shares the Heavy Assimilator voice designed for the Stalker (voices/stalker.json): the account holds more than 20 custom voices, all in use, so no new one is designed. A harder, shouted delivery for the brute.
voice.description: Enormous, slow machine voice of a giant legged alien war machine of a cyborg hive: very deep sub-bass layered voice, as if several huge synthetic voices speak at once an octave apart, grinding metallic overtones and a rumbling engine-like drone beneath every word, cold, emotionless and inevitable, each word heavy and deliberate with long pauses.

select: We are the wall that walks.

smash.prompt: A colossal two-handed sci-fi war hammer slammed into the ground by a giant: an enormous deep earth-shaking impact boom with a crackling green energy discharge, cracking rock and debris thrown up, a heavy metal clang inside the blast, close, outdoors, no music, no voice

punch.prompt: A giant armored robot fist punching hard: a heavy dull metal thud with a deep bass impact and a short crunch of bending steel, quick and punchy, close, no music, no voice

throw.prompt: A giant hurling a huge metal war hammer: a heavy grunt of servos straining, then a deep rushing whoosh of a massive object spinning end over end through the air, whirring away, close, outdoors, no music, no voice

throw_land.prompt: A huge thrown sci-fi war hammer crashing down from the air onto the battlefield: a massive deep ground-shaking slam, a burst of crackling green energy, splintering metal and rock debris raining down, medium distance outdoors, no music, no voice

charge.prompt: A giant armored humanoid war machine breaking into a run: fast, enormous, heavy metal footsteps pounding the ground one after another, each a deep thud, hydraulic hiss and servo whine rising in pitch, close, outdoors, no music, no voice

ram.prompt: A giant armored humanoid war machine charging at full speed: a burst of rapid, earth-shaking heavy metal footfalls accelerating, a roaring hydraulic surge and rushing wind, building to a ramming charge, close, outdoors, no music, no voice

ram_hit.prompt: A giant armored war machine ramming into a tank at full speed: an enormous crunching metal-on-metal collision, armor plate buckling and tearing, a deep bass boom and a crackle of green energy, debris clattering down, close, outdoors, no music, no voice

move.prompt: A giant armored humanoid war machine taking two slow heavy steps: very deep metallic footfalls that shake the ground, hydraulic pistons hissing, servo grind, close, outdoors, no music, no voice

die.prompt: A giant armored humanoid war machine destroyed and toppling: an electric explosion with green arcs discharging, a deep synthetic groan dropping in pitch, a huge steel body crashing face down onto the ground with a long rumbling thud, medium distance outdoors, no music, no voice
